visualCharacteristics.purpose: Ruled expandable rows with a label and chevron toggle
visualCharacteristics.layout: Full-width ruled rows; panel content expands below the label
notable: CSS-only toggle via a visually hidden checkbox
Blocks following the accordion in the same section form the panel of its last item, up to the next accordion

contentPattern.structure: Each row has a label cell and an optional id cell (anchor id); the panel content is the blocks and default content that follow in the same section
contentPattern.rows: One row per item, usually one item per block

usage: Use to collapse long sections of content under labelled toggles
reuseGuidance: Fits FAQ-like or long reference content grouped under short labels; not for content that must be visible at all times
